shots.action: A locked camera holds on the interior face of a bus window at night, the glass filling most of the frame while a sliver of dim, empty seat back and worn chrome rail sit at the lower left. Outside the window the dark street dissolves into soft out-of-focus pools of amber and red light. Rain has already sheeted the pane: hundreds of beads cling to the surface, and a few heavy drops begin to drag downward, cutting clear lines through the film of condensation. The camera does not move; only the water travels, each streak wobbling slightly as it gathers mass and forks around an older trail. Rain drums steadily against the glass and the low, muffled thrum of the bus engine runs underneath it.

shots.action: The shot cuts to an extreme close view of the same wet glass, the frame almost entirely filled by a single large droplet sliding down the pane. The droplet trembles at the head of its track, gathering smaller beads as it goes, swelling and darkening, and its curved surface carries a tiny inverted image of the streetlights outside. Behind it the condensation haze glows faintly and other threads of water slide past out of focus, their motion slow and viscous. Near the end of the shot the droplet meets a slower bead, hesitates, and pulls it into itself, then continues down and out of the bottom of the frame. The rain's patter is louder and closer here, each impact a soft tap on the pane.

shots.action: The shot transitions to a wider, slightly higher view of the whole window again, the pane now heavily streaked with long wavering rivulets. Beyond the glass, passing headlights bloom and smear into long amber and white bars that stretch and slide across the wet surface as the bus moves, their reflections dragging over the droplets and breaking into glitter at the edges of each bead. The interior stays dark and steady, the chrome rail catching one thin, trembling highlight. A fresh rush of water sheets down the upper corner of the pane and the streaks redraw themselves, the light bars continuing to slide and stretch until the frame settles into the same patient, closed-in stillness it began with. Rain continues its even patter, and the engine note sinks a little lower.
